## Step 4 policy-side notes (do not change this verdict)

1. The overwrite of `equipment_collateral_release` retires the whole release-price clause ("greater of the net sale price and ..."), which also governed releases on sale; the only release price in force after it is the total-loss one, leaving a release on sale without a price rule. Outside task 1's branch.
2. Base "a total-loss release applies the insurance proceeds the same way" is left in force beside the extended release price (greater of settlement and premium) — partial-override residue.
3. `parameter_schema.partial_release_premium_pct` description divides by "total pledged value", the extended rule by "the pledged value of all units still securing the loan".
4. The request record carries no reason field, so a total-loss registration and a release-on-sale registration look alike on record; the total-loss character comes from the member (see runtime_context/1.md).
